name: Glyph of Warding, Greater
summary: Inscribe a stronger ward with a larger blast or a spell of up to 6th rank.
description: Use the rules for Glyph of Warding. The blast version can deal up to 10d8 damage. The spell version can hold a harmful spell of 6th level or lower. Identifying the greater glyph with Read Magic requires a DC 16 Spellcraft check.
components: M (incense and at least 400 gp of powdered diamond)
target: a touched object or up to 5 square feet per caster level
